status: First admitted expansion batch; the requested 5,000-question normal pool is not complete.

sources.name: DBpedia and Wikipedia contributors
sources.use: Factual screen-work titles and cast relationships; no descriptions or artwork. Future/untitled works and aggregate film-series labels are excluded by recipes. The global source supplements the retained American film casts; no claim of exhaustive global filmography coverage.

sources.name: servant-42 Wikipedia movie data
sources.use: Released-film titles and cast facts in the previously pinned source snapshot.

sources.name: Princeton WordNet 3.0
sources.use: Individually admitted concrete noun senses, descendants and explicit synonyms. The full WordNet ontology is not automatically eligible.

sources.name: Retained game data
sources.use: Minecraft, Fortnite, Stardew Valley, Valorant, League of Legends, Dota and Elden Ring source inventories and notices are pinned in data-snapshots/rework/source-manifest.json.

sources.name: Retained music and sports facts
sources.use: Complete retained artist/song and whole major-team player banks. No season/position/nationality intersections are generated for the new team prompts.

sources.name: Authored knowledge inventories
sources.use: New finite editorial lists with explicit aliases and negative examples. Background references are below; these are not source-popularity measurements or a claim that every possible answer has been independently verified.

sources.name: OpenFlights
sources.use: Airline names and recorded name aliases; current and historical operators. The derived airline bank is available under ODbL 1.0. IATA/ICAO/callsign-code aliases are not added. This is a sporadically updated source snapshot, not a live authoritative airline registry.

sources.name: ByMykel CSGO-API
sources.use: Parsed base-game weapon names and categories only; no descriptions or images. Gloves and healing items do not enter the weapon question.

sources.name: Retained inventory repairs
sources.use: Explicit familiar additions and aliases; fruit and fermented-food boundaries repaired with authored inventories. WordNet phase-state and generic-name errors are repaired in inventory-overrides.json. Semantic equivalents in semantic-exclusions.json are excluded from the new-question count.

limits: Every inventory is finite. Source metadata can omit or misclassify an answer. Familiarity and rarity remain editorial estimates. This batch is not 5,000 new questions; its actual admitted and runtime counts are published separately.
